messages:
olivia: quick proposal — introduce an opt-in staging header so we can route older clients to a compat shim during the v5 schema migration. thinking header name `X-Compat-Staging: v4->v5` or `X-Compat-Mode: staging:<tag>`
ryan: for clarity — is this opt-in only from clients or can the proxy inject for canary cohorts?
anita: SDKs can emit the header for rollout cohorts. we should also support proxy-injection for non-updated clients behind the same LB. that lets product do targeted trials. :+1:
kevin: watch out for auth/mtls implications — proxy injection needs to preserve client identity for auditing. can't have proxy spoofing user headers unless we add signed header mechanism.
olivia: agreed. plan: 1) SDK opt-in header for early adopters 2) proxy-injection path with header signed by envoy using `x-signed-compat` 3) compat-shim reads signed header and asserts issuer.
maya: important: caching/Vary — if we route by header we must ensure CDN/edge caches include it in the cache key. add `Vary: X-Compat-Mode` or we'll get cross-traffic.
sre-bot: incident-note: last time we used a custom header for routing, we hit an NGINX buffer mismatch. add config test in staging.
kevin: also ensure metrics tag — mark requests as `compat_cohort=staging/<tag>` so we can measure p50,p95 error/regressions separately.
olivia: draft envoy route snippet (staging):
```yaml
- match:
    prefix: "/v5/"
    headers:
      - name: "x-compat-mode"
        exact_match: "staging:canary-3"
  route:
    cluster: compat-shim-v4-to-v5
    prefix_rewrite: "/v4/"
```
anita: looks good. shim should be idempotent and limited to surface-level translation (headers+body keys), not business logic. keep it tiny.
ryan: question — how do we fail-over? if shim errors, fallback to naive passthrough or return 426?
olivia: fallback policy: 1) if shim returns 5xx -> route to v5 with translation disabled + add header `X-Compat-Failure: shim` and increment metric. 2) if translation leads to semantic mismatch we surface a `Compat-Check-Failed` event to tracing and return 424 with user-friendly message.
maya: add an automated canary job that compares outputs: sample requests sent to both shim path and native v5, run diffs on tokens and heuristics, alert on divergence > threshold.
kevin: for rollout timeline propose: week 0 SDK opt-ins + internal canary, week 1 proxy-injection for 10% static cohort, week 3 increase 50% if metrics green, week 5 retire shim when cohort usage < 1% for 2 weeks.
olivia: ops note — add a feature flag in console `compat.staging.enabled` and a toggle per-customer. avoid global flips.
sre-bot: reminder: ensure `Vary` and `Cache-Control: private` for customer-specific routing. otherwise one tenant may leak responses.
deploy-bot: deploy finished: compat-shim-v1 pushed to staging (build 2026.03.18-78) — smoke tests passed. :rocket:
anita: next steps: write short RFC for signing header + envoy config, add SDK opt-in patch, implement small shim container with translation table. I'll take the RFC.
olivia: perfect. tagging @product for rollback policy sign-off. thanks everyone. :sparkles:
